root.name: Ruy Lopez: Rabinovich Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. O-O b5 6. Bb3 d6 7. Ng5 d5 8. exd5 Nd4 9. Re1 Bc5 10. Rxe5+ Kf8

overview: Black counters with ...d5 and ...Nd4, allowing Rxe5+ and Kf8, giving pawns for an attack on the exposed White king and the b3 bishop. White can keep the material but must defend against the pins and checks. This is an old, rare line and the details are uncertain to me.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawns and trade off the attackers
Play Nf3 and defend against Nxb3

black_ideas.idea: Use the pin and ...Nxb3 to attack the king
Exploit the open lines on the e-file and d-file

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White ahead two pawns, Black king on f8

character.notes: Both sides risk a lot early.

soundness.reason: White should be able to keep the material.

structure.reason: Centre opened by exd5 and Rxe5.

plans.reason: Black plays for development and the exposed king.
